name: cli-session-buffer-is-pending-not-durable
body: A buffered change is a pending intention, not a durable fact. A mutation admitted to a live session performs no file I/O: it validates against and applies to the live database the session holds, and the node file it yields is reconstructible from that database and the buffer. The on-disk node files are durable only after a save's commit, and `db.lbug` is a derived index rebuilt from the node files. A read that reaches the live session observes the buffered intention; a read that opens the database directly observes the last saved state.
